manifest.title_fil: Tukuyin ang isyu kasama ang komunidad
manifest.title_en: Identify the issue with the community
objectives_fil: Bumuo ng pahayag ng isyu na may iniulat na ebidensiya, pananaw ng apektadong residente at tanong na kailangan pang linawin.
objectives_en: Write an issue statement with reported evidence, affected residents’ perspectives and a question still to clarify.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gumawa ng issue card: ano ang naiulat, sino ang apektado, sino ang hindi pa naririnig at ano ang itatanong.
sections.takeaway_en: Make an issue card: reported concern, affected people, missing voices and the next question.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ito ang tiyak na naiulat; kailangan pang linawin ang lawak at dahilan.
sections.takeaway_en: This is the specific report; its extent and causes still need clarification.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang ebidensiyang mayroon ang grupo?
check.prompt_en: What evidence does the group currently have?

options.fil: Tamad ang lahat ng hindi nakarating sa BHS.
options.en: Everyone who missed the visit is lazy.

options.fil: Tiyak na ayaw ng walang cellphone na makilahok.
options.en: People without phones definitely refuse to participate.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Bansag ito; hindi ito napatunayan ng mga ulat. 2: Hindi pa naririnig ang kanilang pananaw. 3: Ito ang tiyak na naiulat; kailangan pang linawin ang lawak at dahilan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a label, not something established by the reports. 2: Their perspectives have not yet been heard. 3: This is the specific report; its extent and causes still need clarification.

sections.takeaway_fil: May tiyak na ulat, apektadong grupo, nawawalang pananaw at tanong; walang bansag o personal na detalye.
sections.takeaway_en: Includes a specific report, affected group, missing perspective and question without labels or personal details.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kasama ang apektado sa pagtukoy ng magagamit na solusyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Affected people help identify a workable solution.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat gawin bago pumili ng paraan ng pagpapabalita?
check.prompt_en: What should happen before choosing an update channel?

options.fil: Piliin agad ang chat dahil iyon ang gamit ng lider.
options.en: Choose chat immediately because the leader uses it.

options.fil: Ilista ang personal na kondisyon ng lahat sa pampublikong poster.
options.en: List everyone’s personal health conditions on a public poster.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Kasama ang apektado sa pagtukoy ng magagamit na solusyon. 2: Maaaring patuloy na hindi maabot ang walang cellphone. 3: Hindi kailangan ang personal na kondisyon para linawin ang daan ng balita.
check.feedback_en: 1: Affected people help identify a workable solution. 2: People without phones may still be excluded. 3: Personal conditions are unnecessary for clarifying update channels.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.

assets.alt_en: Three boxes: Listen, Check evidence, Agree together.
